summary: T1 item 8: measurements/characterization.md is the one aggregated, current, per-spec-row rollup for this block, and it names the sim/<slug>/records/ (or layout/ldo-core/reports/) evidence record behind every verdict. It is generated by measurements/build_characterization_report.py, never hand-edited, byte-reproducible against an unchanged tree, and carries a --check mode that fails when it has drifted from the evidence it cites. Item 8 asks for that aggregation artifact to exist and be current -- it does NOT ask for every row in it to pass, and this pass verdict must not be read as if it did: the report currently reads FAIL on 7 of the 13 rows that carry a graded verdict (Dropout, Load regulation, Load transient, PSRR, Iq, Area, Stability), PASS on 6 (Output, Line regulation, Current limit, Startup/soft-start, Enable/shutdown, Thermal), and N/A on 3 further rows. Area gained its first verdict with issue #236 (routed core 0.4468 mm2 against the ratified < 0.1 mm2: FAIL, kept honestly; no bound was touched); issue #318 re-measured the current routed core at 0.4508 mm2, still FAIL, with the four schematic capacitors not drawn, official-deck DRC FAIL and LVS stale disclosed in the area record. Output moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #164: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- only the mc-output-accuracy bench's initial-condition contract, see design/README.md "#164". Thermal moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #189, on the same footing: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- one value in the sim/thermal bench's `.nodeset` seed card (EA_TAIL) was written as if it tracked VIN when a three-supply measurement puts its supply slope at 0.24 V/V, which is what left two corners tripping the #171 solver-diagnostic gate in the superseded record; correcting it takes the bench to 15/15 PASS with zero solver diagnostics. See sim/README.md "#189". Line regulation moved FAIL -> PASS with issue #196, on that same footing: no ratified bound was touched and the DUT is unchanged -- the sim/line-regulation bench drove EN at the corner runner's 'vsup' label while its own VVIN was 'alter'ed 2.97-3.63V INSIDE every corner, so the VIN=3.63V point of every *_2.97v corner ran with EN 0.66V below VIN, which is #187's EN-below-VIN geometry (five PMOS shutdown clamps whose sources are VIN) and leaves no solver diagnostic for the #171 gate to catch. With EN at the instantaneous VIN the full 45-corner matrix is 45/45 PASS (worst 0.595 mV/V at 1mA, 0.368 mV/V at 50mA, against the ratified 5 mV/V bound), and the superseded record's five FAILing corners were exactly the *_125c_2.97v column. See sim/README.md "#196". Those FAILs are item 5's subject matter and item 5 is unmet here. See signoff/README.md for the full reading.
